card.statement:
For $\mathscr{A}_{1}$ , $\mathscr{A}_{2}$ in $\mathrm{P}_{{G_{\mathcal{O}}}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{k})$ , there exists a canonical isomorphism

$\mathsf{H}^{\bullet}\bigl(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}\times\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},{}^{p}\hskip-1.0pt\mathscr{H}^{0}(\mathscr{A}_{1}\mathchoice{\mathbin{\mathop{\boxtimes}^{L}}_{\mathbf{k}}}{\boxtimes^{L}_{\mathbf{k}}}{\boxtimes^{L}_{\mathbf{k}}}{\boxtimes^{L}_{\mathbf{k}}}\mathscr{A}_{2})\bigr)\cong\mathsf{H}^{\bullet}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathscr{A}_{1})\otimes_{\mathbf{k}}\mathsf{H}^{\bullet}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathscr{A}_{2}).$
card.label: Lemma 10.10

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
